prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Katy, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1203; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Katy, Texas. Please state your full understanding of what happened.

A: Sure. I was pulling out of a parking space near the store entrance. It was a busy afternoon and the lot was packed, so I was going slowly, maybe a few miles an hour.

Q: Where were you headed when the impact occurred?

A: I was heading toward the exit lane that runs along the front of the building. I had my turn signal on because I wanted to get out and go down the row.

Q: What did you see as you backed out and started forward?

A: Honestly, I didn't see the other vehicle until it was already there. It came down the aisle from my right, and it hit the rear quarter panel of my car on the passenger side. I felt a jolt and my seatbelt locked up hard.

Q: Did you stop your vehicle before impact?

A: I had almost stopped. I tapped the brakes once I saw movement, but there wasn't enough room to avoid it.

Q: Were you able to get out of the vehicle afterward?

A: Yes, but my right shoulder was hurting right away. I think I twisted it when I grabbed the wheel and turned to look back. It's gotten worse since then, and I've been having trouble lifting my arm above my head.

Q: Have you sought medical attention for the shoulder?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same day and they told me to follow up with my regular doctor. I have an appointment scheduled.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm willing to provide any records you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
